title: Remote approval
responsibility: Lets a computer user grant selected projects and optional agent permission to a requesting phone.

inputs.name: RemoteApproval.request
inputs.description: Required phone request supplying name, platform, device identity and pairing identity. Approval sends both displayed identities; denial sends the pairing identifier.

inputs.name: RemoteApproval.projects
inputs.description: Required project choices; none are initially selected. An empty list explains that a local project is needed.

inputs.name: RemoteApproval.store
inputs.description: Host state providing busy and approve/deny operations. Approval receives selected project identifiers and agents=false unless explicitly checked. Operation failures are delegated to this store.

outputs.name: RemoteApproval
outputs.description: Request fieldset showing phone identity, project checkboxes and Plan/Change permission. Approve is disabled while busy or without a chosen project; Deny is disabled while busy. Submits exactly the selected project list and agent flag.
